reason: Primary purpose is a DeepSeek Harness document-reading plugin: it ingests PDF papers, converts them into structured selectable text with figure/equation rendering, and provides a web-panel interface for reading and asking questions on selected text, with optional per-project paper workspace storage.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，在右侧阅读面板中读取并解析论文 PDF，生成可选中文本与图表、公式展示，并支持基于选中文本的提问。
summaries.en: This DeepSeek Harness plugin reads PDF papers in a side reader panel, converts them into selectable structured text with figure and equation rendering, and supports asking questions on selected text.

capabilities: Accepts and stores uploaded PDF files for local conversion
Converts PDF content to structured selectable text
Renders figures and display equations as images
Provides a side-panel reader UI and selection-based question prompts
Creates and manages per-project paper artifacts in the local workspace

reasons.code: README describes PDF upload/structure extraction workflow with poppler tools and layout reconstruction, plus selectable text output.
README states features include right-side reader panel, ask dialog from text selection, and project creation storing paper.md/html/images in Paper workspace.
package.json exports lib/index.js/lib/client.js and declares a web client patch, confirming a host/client plugin with UI and HTTP route behavior.
